summary.root_cause: Exception handler in save() only caught OSError, leaving temp files orphaned when other exceptions (ValueError, etc.) occurred during file operations inside the try block.
summary.fix_approach: Changed except clause from 'except OSError:' to 'except Exception:' to ensure temp file cleanup on any exception.
